kebab_example: aliyun agentcore create-agent-version --workspace-id ws-0123456789abcdef01234 --agent-id agent-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateAgentVersion

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AgentCore workspace where the agent resides
parameters.help_zh: 智能体所在的 AgentCore 工作空间 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the managed or custom agent
parameters.help_zh: 托管智能体或自定义智能体 ID
parameters.name: agent_id

fields.help_en: The description of the version. It can be up to 1,024 characters in length and cannot be modified after being saved
fields.help_zh: 版本描述，最多 1024 个字符，保存后不可修改
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The custom display name specified by the user. After leading and trailing whitespaces are removed, the name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, spaces, and punctuation marks, but cannot contain control characters. The version name must be unique among undeleted versions under the same agent and is case-sensitive. It cannot be modified after being saved. The version number, agentVersion, is generated by the system and is not determined by this field
fields.help_zh: 用户自定义的展示名称，去除首尾空白后为 1 至 128 个字符，可包含中文、大小写字母、空格和标点，不能包含控制字符。同一 Agent 下未删除的版本名称唯一，区分大小写，保存后不可修改。版本号 agentVersion 由系统生成，不由此字段决定
fields.name: version_name

parameters.help_en: The request body for saving a version
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token generated by the client. This is a reserved parameter, and the backend does not currently provide persistent idempotency guarantees
parameters.help_zh: 客户端生成的幂等令牌，当前为预留参数，后端暂不提供持久化幂等保证
parameters.name: client_token

code.description_en: The business status code. The value is SUCCESS if the request is successful, or an error code if the request fails
code.description_zh: 业务状态码，请求成功时为 SUCCESS，失败时为错误码

data.description_en: The details of the saved fixed agent version. If a duplicate submission matches an existing version, the existing version is returned
data.description_zh: 已保存的智能体固定版本详情；重复提交命中已有版本时返回该已有版本

agentId.description_en: The ID of the managed or custom agent to which the version belongs
agentId.description_zh: 版本所属的托管智能体或自定义智能体 ID

agentVersion.description_en: The version number generated by the system in an incrementing manner for the agent, such as v1 and v2. It is used for querying, deleting, and referencing versions in service endpoints
agentVersion.description_zh: 系统按 Agent 递增生成的版本号，例如 v1、v2。查询、删除版本及服务端点引用版本时使用

artifactStatus.description_en:
Indicates only whether the version template and artifact archiving is complete, and does not represent the deployment or running status. Valid values:
READY: Complete.
INVALID: Archiving is missing or inconsistent
artifactStatus.description_zh: 仅表示版本模板与制品归档是否完整，不代表部署或运行状态。READY 为完整，INVALID 为归档缺失或不一致

additionalProperties.description_en: The values of the agent configuration items when the version is saved. The keys are the data field names returned by GetManagedAgent or GetCustomAgent, such as name, instruction, and model. The value types depend on the fields and can be strings, numbers, Boolean values, objects, or arrays
additionalProperties.description_zh: 版本保存时的 Agent 配置项的值。键为 GetManagedAgent 或 GetCustomAgent 返回的 data 字段名，如 name、instruction、model；值类型随字段而定，可能为字符串、数值、布尔值、对象或数组

configuration.description_en: For a managed agent, the structure is consistent with the data structure of GetManagedAgent. For a custom agent, the structure is consistent with the data structure of GetCustomAgent. The data masking rules are the same
configuration.description_zh: 托管智能体与 GetManagedAgent 的 data 结构一致，自定义智能体与 GetCustomAgent 的 data 结构一致，脱敏规则相同
configuration.example: {"agentId":"agent-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef","workspaceId":"ws-0123456789abcdef01234","name":"customer-service","description":"客服智能体","status":"Running","latestSpecVersion":2,"instruction":"你是一名客服助手。"}
configuration.title_en: 版本保存时的 Agent 配置
configuration.title_zh: 版本保存时的 Agent 配置

createdAt.description_en: The time when the version was saved, in ISO 8601 UTC format
createdAt.description_zh: 版本保存的时间，采用 ISO 8601 UTC 格式
createdAt.title_en: 版本创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 UTC 格式
createdAt.title_zh: 版本创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 UTC 格式

createdBy.description_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account of the caller who saved the version. If a RAM user calls the operation, this value is the UID of the Alibaba Cloud primary account to which the RAM user belongs
createdBy.description_zh: 保存该版本的调用者阿里云账号 UID；RAM 用户调用时为其所属阿里云主账号 UID

description.description_en: The version description provided when the version is saved. It can be up to 1,024 characters in length. If no description is provided during saving, this field is empty
description.description_zh: 保存版本时填写的版本描述，最多 1024 个字符；保存时未填写则为空

targetSpecVersion.description_en: The effective release serial number of the agent when the version is saved, which is the effectiveSpecVersion at that time. This value does not change after the version is saved
targetSpecVersion.description_zh: 保存版本时 Agent 已生效的发布流水号，即当时的 effectiveSpecVersion。版本保存后该值不再变化
targetSpecVersion.title_en: 保存时固化的 Agent 发布流水号，即保存时的 effectiveSpecVersion
targetSpecVersion.title_zh: 保存时固化的 Agent 发布流水号，即保存时的 effectiveSpecVersion

versionName.description_en: The display name specified by the user when the version is saved. For versions saved earlier without a recorded name, the agentVersion is returned
versionName.description_zh: 保存版本时用户指定的展示名称。早期保存且未记录名称的版本返回 agentVersion

workspaceId.description_en: The ID of the AgentCore workspace where the agent to which the version belongs resides
workspaceId.description_zh: 版本所属智能体所在的 AgentCore 工作空间 ID

message.description_en: The response message. The value is success if the request is successful, or an error message if the request fails
message.description_zh: 响应消息，请求成功时为 success，失败时为错误信息

requestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate and troubleshoot the request
requestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查请求
requestId.title_en: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查请求
requestId.title_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位和排查请求

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
